# Teacher evidence checkpoints
Separate teacher file; not access-protected.
E1: row totals[2,5,0],empty[]; stocksum2. Search integer midpoint, inclusive candidate loop, same searched key ordering; -1 contract explicit. Independent creation/trace needed; copying examples is not sufficient.
E2: existing fault lab total 3,available 2,quantity 1,activeTrue; firstreturn ->3/inactive; second must reject and remain 3. Observe actual state/version, not invented screenshot. Do not weaken expected tests to make faulty code pass.
E3: use earlier load guide’s expected counts and no-overwrite behaviour.100records returns 25/active 75;1000returns250/active 750. Record measured times, not universal limits. Report environment limitations.
E4: example Studio.0/26(31 required,62 usable),Staff .64/28(13 required,14 usable),Devices .80/29(6 required,6 usable),Guests.88/29(5 required,6 usable). Gateways .1,.65,.81,.89. E5: compare actual symbol drawings with SCSA table; do not accept generic labelled rectangles as verified symbol fidelity. The source text identifies perimeter firewall convention. Local source image extraction was unavailable during preparation, so visual symbol fidelity is explicitly pending. No source icons are reproduced in the pack. Confirm reference page visually before assessment. Check intermediary/end devices, links, prefixes/gateway routing and security/performance justification.
E6: record target authorisation, observed commands/output and interpretation. Ping success is ICMP evidence, not bulk-bandwidth or web-health proof. Missing intermediate traceroute replies can coexist with destination response. No predetermined RTT or loss threshold is supplied.
Evidence decisions: observed / partly demonstrated / pending; attach reason and next action. All learners and independent review remain pending until actual work is checked.
